//: Example wiring for the 4SYNC ARCH guard + session-debt hook (hooks/pre_tool_use.py). Copy to .claude/settings.local.json and adjust paths.
//guards: pre_tool_use.py runs FIVE structural guards (KERNEL-write, ABBA-format, sandbox-git, STATUS-snapshot, boring-guard) plus a session-debt recorder that flags a session which worked but never ran an explicit close.
//rollout: Start with ARCH_HOOKS_MODE=warn (violations logged, never blocked). After ~a week of clean runs, flip to 'enforce'. 'off' disables entirely.
//paths: Adjust the interpreter + script + log paths to your checkout. Forward slashes work on Windows too; use the FULL python path if bare 'python' is shadowed (e.g. the Windows Store stub).
//activate: After creating this file, reload config: open /hooks once, or restart the session — a freshly-created .claude/ is not watched mid-session.
//env: Optional: ARCH_DEBT=0 disables the session-debt recorder; ARCH_MANIFEST sets the manifest filename the boring-guard watches (default 4sync.yaml).
